table.name: Torque Efficiency vs Ignition Retard
table.description: Descriptor(s): 0x2C8DC, 0x2C918, 0x2C978. Shared by descriptors 0x2C8DC (0x853C4 -> FFFF0AA8), 0x2C918 (0x857A8 torque multiplier), 0x2C978 (0x8637C). Evidence: Index: 0x857A8 (from 0x87478) uses FFFF0498 - Ignition Total Timing 046C (0498 = copy of 03D1, 0x9D688; 0.5 deg, signed) >= 0; 0x853C4 uses FFFF03D1 - FFFF049E + 32 (or 03D1 - ((04A4+04BB)*180/256 + 049E - 32), knock terms x*45/128 deg -> *180/256 = 0.5 deg) -> FFFF0AA8; 0x8637C uses 03D1 - FFFF03D3 (0.5 deg). Axis = retard below the torque-model reference timing 03D1 in 0.5 deg. Output: 0x857A8 m = T(retard)*16384/FFFF0BF6 (0BF6 = copy of 0AA8 = same table at the reference retard, 0x9A698) and then torque = 16000 + (tq-16000)*m/16384 (form (tq*m>>14) - m*250/256), i.e. T(retard)/T(ref) is a torque multiplier; 0x8637C forms (0AA8<<13)/T, floor 0x2000 (= 1.0); 0x9B384/T_02D890 invert it. Only ratios of T and the inverse map use it; the data hold 32768 at zero retard and the inverse lookup clamps at 32768, so x/32768 = efficiency relative to zero retard. Lookup result stored to: 0008637c:*param_12, FFFF0AA8.

table.name: Torque Efficiency Filter Coefficient (RPM) [0x8637C -> FFFF19A8]
table.description: Descriptor(s): 0x2C96C. Evidence: 0x8637C: when the efficiency ratio branch is active, FUN_0016B4D8(&FFFF19A8, target, T(rpm FFFF2994)) with 0x16B4D8: y += (x - y)*k/65536, so T is a first-order filter gain (fraction per execution, 65536 = 1.0).

Evidence: 0x86680 (disasm 0x866EE..0x8672E): FFFF0ADA = min(FFFF0ADC, max(scalar 0x12484, a + b + c + FFFF0AE8 - 48000)) with a, b, c torque terms (defaults 0x3E80 = 0 Nm, scalars 0x1244C..0x12450), i.e. a torque-type sum, so FFFF0AE8 is torque type; 0x85434: FFFF0AAA = min(FFFF0AFE, T_02C8E8(rpm)) and FFFF0AF8 = 0AAA - 0AE8 + 16000 (torque difference) -> 0AAA torque type; 0x85940: FFFF0ABC = delayed 16000 + (0AAA-16000)*FFFF0AFC/32768 (torque type). 0x86A50: FFFF0AE8 = T(rpm FFFF2994, filtered MAP FFFF19AA). Torque type: Nm = (x-16000)/80, anchored at 0xC3FA8 (kW->Nm via 60000/2pi, stored *80+16000, clamps = u16 range). Lookup result stored to: FFFF0AE8 (Torque Term 0AE8).

Evidence: 0xBDD60 (from 0xBE0E8, call 0xBE512; p1 FFFF299C rpm/25, p2 FFFF0542, p3 FFFF0458, p4 FFFF0541, p7 Vehicle Speed FFFF65A1, p8 FFFF66B0, p9 Coolant FFFEEEDE, p10 FFFEEED4, p11 rpm, p12 load FFFF09B4, p13 FFFF049E; output p15 = r9(FFFF0458)+218 = FFFF0532). When p6 set, 65A1 != 0xFF and p14 set: x = Ta(rpm/25, coolant) + Tb(0542, coolant) + Tc(c1, coolant) + Td(c2, coolant) (signed int8 sum, saturated); with p14 clear the B set is used. c1 counts executions while FFFF66B0 == 3, c2 is a second execution counter. FFFF0532 = x when 0541 < 2 (else 0458). 0x86B58 (0x87478): Ignition Timing 03D3 = 0532 when FFFF0530 == 2; 03D3 is 0.5 deg (0x88478 compares |03D3 - 046C|), so the sum and each term are 0.5 deg.

table.name: MAP Transient Rise Threshold (A: FFFEEF76.6=0)
table.description: Descriptor(s): 0x2EC08. Evidence: 0xCEF4C (from 0xCF4B4): FFFF19D0 = filter(FFFF09B8 MAP, k=0x199A/65536 via 0x16B4D8) -> FFFF0F52; FFFF0F50 = FFFEE6F8 (MAP, kPa x/256) - FFFF19D0, i.e. a MAP change in kPa (x/256, signed). Lookups use p1 = FFFF09B8 (MAP, kPa x/256). Variant by p9 = FFFEEF76.6 (A = clear, B = set). Rise: flag ECD3D = (R <= 0F50) with R = T_rise - T_rise_hys while ECD3D was set; drop: flag ECD40 = (0F50 <= D) with D = T_drop + T_drop_hys while ECD40 was set. Comparisons/sums with 0F50 give kPa x/256.

table.name: Engine Speed Change Threshold vs IAT (gear 1, inactive: 0x17F4A=1)
table.description: Descriptor(s): 0x2F250. Evidence: 0xE541C (from 0xE4728; p1 FFFEF192, p2 FFFF2B0C, p3 FFFF2B0E, p4 IAT FFFEEEE2, p5 Gear FFFF03AC, p6 FFFF0D70). Disassembly 0xE543C..0xE54DE: when calibration byte 0x17F4A == 0, flag FED314.2 = (T_gear(IAT) <= |FFFEF192|) (gear 1-4 own tables, 5/6 T_02F280). 0x4D04C: FFFEF192 = sat16(FFFF2ADA - previous FFFF2ADA) = change of Engine Speed (OBD copy, rpm = x*25/128) per execution, so T is rpm change per execution.
